source.source_locator: 消防法 第13条の2第4項第1号

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 免状返納命令の日から1年を経過しない者には、都道府県知事が免状を交付しないことができる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 返納命令後6か月経過すればこの不交付事由から外れる。
evidence.reasoning_path: return-order date -> elapsed 10 months -> compare with one-year boundary -> discretionary non-issuance applies

collision.note: Batch 2 Tier B temporal boundary; distinct from C011 two-year conviction boundary.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-2(4)(1) directly supports the one-year post-return-order boundary; the ten-month scenario is a material decision boundary.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations. C016 adds insufficient incremental practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
